scope.description: State-scoped inventory of raw SLBC field labels. It is a standardization-readiness artifact, not a comparable dataset.

policy.indicatorIdentity: State slug plus exact raw source field; no cross-state semantic equivalence is asserted.
policy.units: Not inferred from field names; review is required.
policy.measureTypes: Not inferred from field names; review is required.
policy.lexicalMatches: Exact shared labels are discovery candidates only and do not establish comparable definitions, units, or periods.
policy.numericCoverage: Counts syntactically numeric cells, including zero. It does not establish analytical validity, complete geography, or comparability.
policy.missingValues: Absent keys, blank strings, JSON nulls, and explicit _, -, NA, N/A markers are counted separately. Their source meaning is unresolved; none is converted to zero, suppression, or not-applicable.
policy.numericSyntax: Plain decimals and valid Indian/Western comma grouping are numeric. Percentage suffixes, spreadsheet errors, multiple numeric tokens, malformed grouping, and non-finite values remain separate classes. No number is selected or unit inferred from an ambiguous cell.
policy.coverageDenominator: Absent counts use the state's existing raw district-period records. They do not imply the field should exist for every record. Legacy period/district counts describe key presence, including blank cells.
policy.sharedPeriodCoverage: Intersection of numeric reporting months across every state holding the exact label; a state with no numeric values makes it empty. Period overlap alone does not establish comparable measures.
policy.reviewExamples: At most two source-order examples per non-numeric class per field. JSON Pointers locate cells in the hashed local artifact, not upstream source pages. Free text is not copied into this inventory.
policy.nextGate: Review definitions, units, measure types, geography vintage, and provenance before promoting any field to standardized preview.
